subject: How to include .Rprofile in deploy to shinyapps.io?

messages.author: 1d22b88696fb889c
messages.subject: How to include .Rprofile in deploy to shinyapps.io?
parts:
I use .Rprofile to set options to define authentication credentials, API keys, etc. to keep sensitive info out of the code.

Creating a .Rprofile file in the root folder of my Shiny app works when I run it locally (i.e. the file is loaded by R, and option values are available via getOption()). But the .Rprofile file does not appear to be copied to shinyapps.io when the app is deployed there. Why?

Thanks,
Eric

messages.author: 1d22b88696fb889c
messages.subject: Re: How to include .Rprofile in deploy to shinyapps.io?
parts:
After more experimentation, it appears that when publishing an app to shinyapps.io, 'dot' files are ignored. 

I tried explicitly 'sourcing' both ".Rprofile" and ".Rconfig" (just to see if it was ignoring a specific filename). But, when I used a non-'dot' file (e.g. "config.R"), it worked (i.e. was bundled with the other files when publishing).

Is this behavior intentional?

Thanks,
Eric

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: How to include .Rprofile in deploy to shinyapps.io?
parts:
It is not. We have a fix, I am not sure at the moment the timing of a release.
In the meantime, you should be able to workaround this limitation by using rsconnect:deployApp() to deploy.
